description: The yearly tax on a let property: profit on top of other income, the 20% finance-cost credit for mortgage interest (24% from 2027/28) (Section 24), or the £1,000 property allowance if better. Use for 'how much tax on my buy-to-let rent'.

otherIncome.description: Salary, pension and other taxable income. Defaults to 0.

year.description: The rates: 2026 for 2026/27, or 2027 for 2027/28 and after, when property income rates rise. Defaults to the current tax year's.

yearlyCosts.description: Allowable running costs - agent, repairs, insurance - not the mortgage interest. Defaults to 0.

yearlyMortgageInterest.description: Mortgage interest in the year. Defaults to 0.

name: calculate_let_property_tax
title: Let property tax
